analysis_kind: post-hoc read-only manifest count and source inspection

confirmed_implementation.checkpoint_selection: After each epoch, ordinary inverse validation episodes are scored; select minimum equally weighted mean across eight validation cells.

gradient_loss.notes: Mean binary cross entropy across 2401 independent exact-cent outputs, positive weight (2401 - public note count) / public note count.
gradient_loss.scalar_fields: Squared error of sigmoid outputs against normalized labels.
gradient_loss.weighting: Equal eligible field mean per example, then equal example mean.

confirmed_implementation.local_search: Pitch neighbors begin at plus/minus 100 cents; step sizes halve toward one. An improving current candidate becomes the new best and resets the neighbor queue. Seen patches are omitted. At exhausted one-unit neighborhoods the actor restores the best patch if needed and submits, even if public evaluation budget remains.
confirmed_implementation.pitch_distance_in_training_loss: The BCE term contains no term based on cent distance between the correct bin and an incorrect bin; it is not continuous pitch regression.
confirmed_implementation.search_objective: Pattern/random search directly minimize score(target_audio, candidate_audio)[distance], the mean of spectral convergence plus log-magnitude distance at FFT sizes 512, 2048 and 8192.
confirmed_implementation.search_restarts: No global restart or coarse pitch sweep is implemented by PatternSearchActor.
confirmed_implementation.separate_diagnostics: Envelope RMSE, level error, and evaluator pitch error are reported but do not add separate terms to the optimized distance.

sources.role: Scored best candidate and budget handling
Local neighborhood, step schedule and early completion

confirmed_implementation.training_mode: Supervised parameter estimation, not reinforcement learning.

counting_method.eligible_filter: Include a dataset entry if 'notes_cents' is in entry['episode']['editable_fields']; locked pitch contributes no eligible pitch-head training loss.
counting_method.positive_labels: For every eligible entry, count each note in entry['episode']['target_patch']['notes_cents'] once. Counts preserve repeated observations of a bin across entries.
counting_method.validation_denominator: sum(validation_note_counter.values()); note instances, not targets or distinct bins
counting_method.validation_unseen_note_instances: sum(count for note, count in validation_note_counter.items() if note not in train_note_counter)

hypotheses_not_established_causes: Sparse exact-cent positive supervision may limit pitch generalization; the counts alone do not establish the cause of particular errors.
Model capacity and spectrogram representation may limit initial patch quality; no capacity or representation ablation was run for this diagnostic.
Alternative global/coarse pitch proposals may escape local spectral minima; their effect requires a controlled comparison with fixed weights and matched candidate budgets.

known_review_case.interpretation: This target pitch bin is seen during eligible training; its retained 702-cent failure is not itself an unseen-label example.

scope: Frozen train/validation membership and existing model/search implementation; no training, actor execution, final-test selection, or new quality claim.
suggested_smallest_followup: Freeze weights, objective and the 32-evaluation ceiling; compare current refinement with a coarse/global pitch-proposal variant on development/validation diagnostics. Preserve all cases and actual costs. This is not a confirmatory result; any later final model-selection claim requires fresh held-out membership.
